items.title: Gemini 4 Argon expands into robotics
items.oneliner: Google says Gemini 4 Argon hit 87% on Embodied Reasoning, pushing frontier models from chat into physical action.

items.title: Meta enters the frontier model race
items.oneliner: Meta's Muse Wonder reached frontier-tier benchmarks, but pricing near Opus means distribution, not cost, is its real weapon.

items.title: EmbeddingGemma becomes fast local speech recognition
items.oneliner: An open EmbeddingGemma 2 hack transcribes one hour in 13 seconds on MacBook Air, making private on-device ASR practical.

items.title: AI helped build a Chrome full chain
items.oneliner: XBOW built a Chrome full-chain exploit in six days and earned $250,000, compressing offensive security timelines dramatically.

items.title: Rust's borrow checker hid an old flaw
items.oneliner: An 11-year-old Rust soundness bug shows memory-safety guarantees still depend on edge cases nobody thought were reachable.

items.title: AI crawlers are becoming an infrastructure problem
items.oneliner: One Hacker News post turned into bot traffic hell, with nearly half the load tied to AI summarization crawlers.

items.title: Anthropic rebuilt source control for AI coding
items.oneliner: Anthropic replaced Git workflows after daily merges jumped from 2,500 to 30,000, a preview of AI-generated code at scale.

items.title: AWS makes web apps fit Lambda
items.oneliner: Lambda Web Functions let Express and Next.js run mostly unchanged, signaling serverless is finally adapting to normal web stacks.

items.title: Apple turns idle Macs into a GPU cloud
items.oneliner: Apple's Minions paper shows idle Apple Silicon devices can serve inference, hinting at a cheaper distributed GPU playbook.

items.title: Character.AI enters bankruptcy and asset sale
items.oneliner: Character.AI filed Chapter 11 and agreed to sell assets for $20 million, a sharp reset for consumer AI valuations.
